name: AccessPolicyV3 evaluation
title: AccessPolicyV3 evaluation
description: $evaluate-policy on an AccessPolicyV3 reports the tri-state decision: every row of the rule state table, every combining algorithm at two nesting depths, indeterminate rules counting as denies, and the care team nurse example.

test.name: A false target makes the rule not applicable
An empty target makes the rule not applicable
A false condition makes the rule not applicable
An empty condition makes the rule not applicable, not indeterminate
A true condition on a permit rule permits with the rule's obligations

assert.description: Policy decision: permit. Obligations: audit-purpose, max-results=100.
assert.expression: OperationOutcome.issue.diagnostics = 'Policy decision: permit. Obligations: audit-purpose, max-results=100.'

test.name: A true condition on a deny rule denies
An expression that does not parse is indeterminate
More than one result is indeterminate
deny-overrides: an indeterminate rule outranks a permit
permit-overrides: a permit outranks an indeterminate rule
A permitting parent adds its obligations to its nested rules'

assert.description: Policy decision: permit. Obligations: max-results=10, audit-purpose.
assert.expression: OperationOutcome.issue.diagnostics = 'Policy decision: permit. Obligations: max-results=10, audit-purpose.'

test.name: %request and %principal expose the request and the caller
The care team nurse permits a read and denies a MedicationRequest write
